context_metadata.selection: Reuse exactly the 20 predeclared real snapshots in pi05_parallel_latency_20260926/contexts.json, same set for both bases; no score/outcome selection
context_metadata.scope: Shared real RGB/proprio/action snapshots for native SmolVLA and X-VLA timing; no new collection or closed-loop evaluation

feature_source: each native backbone vision and native text input embeddings; no pi05 cached features/model
latency_wall_source: recorded outer wall_seconds only; no sum/max reconstruction
partial_worker_policy: valid recorded nonwarmup samples retained; worker statuses and missing coverage disclosed
throughput: per worker: sum(count(end_s<=duration_seconds))/sum(duration_seconds); never sum GPUs into one GPU
service_deadline_population: valid completed tasks released inside window, including completions drained after window
